name: Sparkline
remarks: Use the ModifyLocation method to change the location of a single sparkline, and use the ModifySourceData method to change the range of the source data. To work with a group of sparklines at the same time, use the members of the SparklineGroup object.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent SparklineGroup object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Location
properties.description: Returns or sets the location of a single sparkline. Read/write.

properties.name: SourceData
properties.description: Returns or sets the range that contains the source data for a single sparkline. Read/write.

methods.name: ModifyLocation
methods.description: Modifies the location of a single sparkline.

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description: The cell that contains the sparkline.

methods.name: ModifySourceData
methods.description: Modifies the source data for a single sparkline.

parameters.name: Formula
parameters.description: The range that contains the source data.
